name: Folder trays
author: skll
description: App folders for the bar: a folder icon that opens into a row of the apps you picked, like the system tray's drawer. Put as many as you like on the bar; OMAcraft's Bar page makes and edits them.

barWidget.description: A folder of apps that opens and closes on the bar

schema.label: Name
schema.description: Shown on hover, and beside the icon when showLabel is on.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: A Nerd Font glyph, or an icon name or file.

schema.label: Apps
schema.description: Desktop ids (e.g. firefox, org.gnome.Nautilus), or {name, icon, command} for anything else.

schema.label: Opens on
schema.description: click: the folder icon opens and closes it. hover: it opens while the pointer is over it.

schema.label: Opens towards
schema.description: auto: towards the middle of the bar.

schema.label: Close after launching
schema.description: Fold the folder back up once an app is started.

schema.label: Show the name
schema.description: Write the folder's name beside its icon.

schema.label: Close after (s)
schema.description: Fold up after this many seconds without the pointer over it; 0 never.
